instructionminioninfo: Wake all Minions: Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token. Point to the Demon. Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to the other Minions.
instructiondemoninfo: Wake the Demon: Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to all Minions. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
